scope: One focused proof and source-binding review, including author revisions responding to identified issues; not a recursive meta-audit.

published_counterevidence_reused.scope: Historical represented coefficient leakage witness reused; current source retains generic inverse and all-entry mixing, but historical exact bit values are not claimed remeasured on current binary.

theorem_decisions.title: Unique regular triangular root graph and no fold
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Exactly causal declared/reference target; common frozen invertible linear W; C^k callbacks on every recursive state; fixed theta.
theorem_decisions.limits: Not automatic for represented K coefficients; arbitrary finite-difference JVP is not a linear matrix.

theorem_decisions.title: Finite causal majorant certificate without norm contraction
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Nonnegative strictly lower B valid on same product tube; actual candidate defect d; d+B r<=r and finite callback domain.
theorem_decisions.limits: Nilpotent spectral radius zero does not imply small path-weight bounds.

theorem_decisions.title: At most s exact rounds and inexact error convolution
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Exactly causal map; each round reads only previous iterate; root and all iterates inside fixed tube; round errors enclosed.
theorem_decisions.limits: No exact-s claim for near-causal actual map; output weights and assembly rounding remain necessary.

theorem_decisions.title: Independent windows and analytic jet predictor
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Common predictor independent of preceding corrected roots; exact-causal branch identity or uniform actual-map root witness; R>1 holomorphic ball with uniform Rb<1 and invariant radius.
theorem_decisions.limits: Independent local unique roots need not be same branch; coefficient orders/jet convolution costs are not parallel-free.

theorem_decisions.title: Strict counted-cost span reduction
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Same target and output budget; upper bounds include setup, wave schedule, certificate, dispatch, failures and fallback; independently established comparator lower cost exceeds sum.
theorem_decisions.limits: Eight-stage three-wave example is span reduction, not work reduction or measured speed.

theorem_decisions.title: Exact affine invariant dimension reduction
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Exact RHS, J, mass and f_t intertwining; full-column-rank U; invertible W; causal uniqueness or H5 uniqueness plus lifted reduced root inside full tube; physical lift metric and costs included.
theorem_decisions.limits: Nonlinear coordinates, near-invariance, off-manifold projection and strongest-solver asymptotic claims excluded.

theorem_decisions.title: Actual-target near-causal root certificate and geometric rate
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: A=B+E>=0 bounds actual full-map Lipschitz terms on closed tube; B strict lower; S=(I-B)^-1; 0<=norm(S E)<=q<1; verified radius closure; uniform common tube for branch claim.
theorem_decisions.limits: Actual current B/E/q and radius not evaluated; positive certificate-action tail and actual A-power iteration are distinct.

theorem_decisions.title: Whole-stage nonlinear contamination and adjoint influence
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Full-space inverse gain or proved invariant error input subspace; actual U target; Lipschitz stage tubes; residual/operator/RHS/output uncertainty outward bounded.
theorem_decisions.limits: A gain on one observed residual direction cannot certify coupling-generated directions.

theorem_decisions.title: Local truncation upper bound independent of embedded estimator
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Actual coefficient Taylor defects d1..d5 and full-step C6 remainder/resolvent bound, or rigorous reconstruction defect integral including quadrature remainder.
theorem_decisions.limits: No sampling-only derivative/quadrature authority; no implicit exact order condition for stored binary64 coefficients.

theorem_decisions.title: Finite-trajectory global error with metric/time transport
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: G1/G2 for every accepted step; certified initial/time uncertainty; exact-flow logarithmic norm over valid full trajectory tube; positive scales and outward metric ratios.
theorem_decisions.limits: No current native trajectory certificate; stiffness-independent order constant and online future weights require extra premises.

theorem_decisions.title: Optimal continuous residual allocation and discrete sufficient work saving
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: Fixed valid influences; rho(k)<=R q^k+eta with certified 0<q<1; precharged floors/mandatory costs; B>0; same backend scheduled comparator; all extra costs counted.
theorem_decisions.limits: Not generic integer optimum after ceiling except exact integer cases; not universal early-stop speedup; q=0 handled separately.

theorem_decisions.title: Positive parametric scheduled-work complexity reduction
theorem_decisions.necessary_scope: m=2^r, L>=r, b>=1, fixed q=1/2,R=c=1 and weights (2^L,1,...,1); equal certified budget and full overhead condition.
theorem_decisions.limits: Not spatial-n scaling of fixed eight-stage RODAS; bit cost and future global weights not free.

gate_decisions.scope: Withdrawn blanket native no-fold and exact-s-round claim; published coefficient counterevidence invalidates automatic premise transfer.

gate_decisions.reason: Actual current E,q,r/domain enclosures not calculated.
No new native contract implementation/authority integration performed in this theory loop.
G1-G3 witnesses not executed for a full new trajectory.
No new same-accuracy full-cost wall-time execution.

review_findings.issue: Direction-specific inverse gain was allowed for complete propagated stage error.
review_findings.resolution: Full-space gain or proved containing invariant error subspace required.

review_findings.issue: Truncation tau inequality direction obscured certificate authority.
review_findings.resolution: Actual error<=tau; tau is outward evaluated upper bound.

review_findings.issue: Automatic strict-causal native K target conflicted with prior represented-coefficient leakage evidence.
review_findings.resolution: Initial claim explicitly withdrawn; H1/H2 restricted to exact causal targets; H5 positive actual-target rescue supplied conditionally, not executed.

review_findings.issue: Frozen JVP did not establish a linear operator and stage epsilon did not directly equal output budget.
review_findings.resolution: Reference W plus mismatch authority and output coefficient/roundoff transfer explicit.

review_findings.issue: H5 q-bound notation, zero-log edge, and H4 lifted-root tube membership were incomplete.
review_findings.resolution: 0<=norm(T)<=q<1; zero cases handled; lifted reduced root inclusion required.

review_findings.issue: Richardson q=0 edge and earlier model-specific global certificate reuse needed explicit treatment.
review_findings.resolution: One-step/floor special case and L0048 reuse/novelty limit explicit.

complexity_family.asymptotic_regime: fixed b, L >> m log m

homotopy_span_example.scope: stated full counted-cost model; not measured

integration_review.scope: Sections 2.2 and 5 preserve conditional theory vs actual-target/native/global/runtime boundaries; H4 summary now explicitly requires certified uniqueness and lifted root inside full tube.

application_boundaries: No exact causal structure inferred from tiny represented coefficients.
No projection silently changes original target.
No finite rational example proves a generic theorem.
No conditional work/span theorem is a production or wall-time result.
